2011 Ford Crown Victoria SEDAN 4-DR, 4.6L V8 SOHC 16V FFV. - PPV
Being Sold As-Is
Vehicle was used as a patrol vehicle/school resource officer vehicle.
Engine & Transmission: Starts with a boost, vehicle runs and drives, motor misses when hot. Gear shift sticks. Engine light on. No other known issues.
***Vehicle should be towed from lot***
Exterior: White, minors dings and some scratches (descent shape). Decals have been removed and impressions remain. Has filled in holes on truck where antenna was. Body trim missing on driver door. Tires have some dry rot.  * Please see pics*
Interior: Black cloth interior. Rear seat is plastic police bench. Stock AM/FM radio. Tilt steering. Power mirrors, windows and door locks. A/C blows cold (descent shape). *Please see pics*
Clear Title.
Contact Fleet Department at 901-757-7359 for questions pertaining to the vehicle, inspection of the vehicle or pick up of the vehicle. Mon-Fri 7am-330pm

274802578.description: This vintage Cross desk pen set features a Brazilian green onyx base with natural color variations. It includes a gold-tone ballpoint pen displayed upright in a swivel holder mounted on the onyx base. The set comes in its original brown Cross branded box and includes the guarantee, operating instructions, and a template for centering a nameplate. The pen set appears unused and well-preserved with minimal signs of wear. All original packaging and paperwork are included, suitable for collectors or as a classic executive gift.
